rationale: Although the stock is in a strong intraday downtrend below both VWAP ($11.06) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($10.56), midday 1-minute volume has dried up to roughly 1,200–3,800 shares per bar while the bid-ask spread remains wide at 47.8 bps ($0.05). Initiating a short in the bottom 6.5% of the day's range after a drop from $13.11 to $10.47 offers poor reward-to-risk after accounting for spread cost, while a long lacks any structural reclaim or buying volume to counteract the persistent selling pressure.
